premise: Frog has a secret trick but is too shy to show it, until her friends cheer and she does a backflip, and catches a fly on the way down.
inspiration: The boast undone (Aesop's fables of the braggart), turned inside out: the quiet one never boasted, and her friends' cheering is what lets her shine.
lesson: Friends who cheer make it easier to be brave.

en-US.title: Frog's Big Trick
en-US.text: Fox {fox:hop} could run faster than anyone. Deer {deer:pulse} could leap right over a log. [curious] And what can you do, Frog? they asked. Frog {frog:tint #FFB3C6} went pink. I have a trick, she whispered. But it's hard to do with everyone watching. The mushroom {mushroom:wobble} nodded kindly. Fox and Deer {fox:hop} {deer:hop} cheered. You can do it, Frog! One… two… three… [excited] {frog:live} {sfx:boing} Frog sprang up, flipped right over backwards, landed on her lily pad — and snap! caught a fly. {all:face surprised} [gasps] Nobody said a word. Then Fox {fox:spin} spun round, and Deer {deer:hop x2} bounced. {all:face happy} [laughs] Again! Again! [happily] And Frog took a bow, {frog:face happy} {frog:sparkle} the proudest, happiest frog in the whole pond.

es-ES.title: El gran truco de Rana
es-ES.text: Zorro {fox:hop} corría más rápido que nadie. Ciervo {deer:pulse} saltaba por encima de un tronco. [curious] ¿Y tú qué sabes hacer, Rana?, le preguntaron. Rana {frog:tint #FFB3C6} se puso colorada. Sé hacer un truco, susurró. Pero me cuesta con todos mirando. La seta {mushroom:wobble} asintió con cariño. Zorro y Ciervo {fox:hop} {deer:hop} la animaron. ¡Tú puedes, Rana! Una… dos… tres… [excited] {frog:live} {sfx:boing} Rana dio un brinco, una voltereta hacia atrás, cayó en su hoja de nenúfar… ¡y zas!, atrapó una mosca. {all:face surprised} [gasps] Nadie dijo nada. Entonces Zorro {fox:spin} dio una vuelta, y Ciervo {deer:hop x2} dio botes. {all:face happy} [laughs] ¡Otra vez! ¡Otra vez! [happily] Y Rana hizo una reverencia, {frog:face happy} {frog:sparkle} la rana más orgullosa y feliz de toda la charca.
